## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## User and methodology impact

Explain any visible behavior, modeling, data, performance, or compatibility
impact. Write `None` when a category is unaffected.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Tests pass for the affected area.
- [ ] New assumptions and data provenance are explicit.
- [ ] Generated results were reproduced or verified when applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, machine-specific paths, or private data are included.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any user-facing change.
